source_authority: For this approved teaching fixture, accepted business semantics come from the versioned PRD; interface shape comes from the pinned OpenAPI; implementation details are advisory and cannot override a conflict.

methods.name: source-bound requirement extraction
methods.protected_outcome: no unsupported rule reaches test generation
methods.rationale: Stable locators and explicit stop states make generated requirements auditable.

methods.name: state and side-effect contract testing
methods.protected_outcome: invalid state and duplicate refund are detected
methods.decision_rights: test owner selects cases; domain owner approves oracle
methods.oracle: independent expected response and refund-count oracle
methods.rationale: The highest-risk fields need an oracle independent of the implementation.
